reviews.author: Mark HONG
reviews.text:
Jamsil Hangang Park is one of the most popular Hangang parks in Seoul and is a perfect healing space in the city where you can enjoy nature, relaxation, and various activities. It is the perfect place to visit with family, lovers, and friends, and it is also a great place to spend time alone.
1. Beautiful scenery

Jamsil Hangang Park offers a wide, open space where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Hangang River. In particular, Seokchon Lake and Lotte World Tower are close by, so I was able to feel the unique charm of harmonizing the splendor of the city with nature. During sunset time, the glow reflected on the river was fantastic.
2. Family friendly

The park has large lawns and well-maintained walking paths, making it perfect for visiting with children. There are also facilities such as a water park and playground, making it a great environment for children to run around and play. Additionally, there are bicycle rental shops and safe bicycle paths so the whole family can enjoy leisurely bicycle rides together.
3. Various activities

At Jamsil Hangang Park, in addition to basic activities such as walking, running, and biking, you can also enjoy water sports such as kayaking or SUP (stand-up paddleboarding) on the Han River. In warm weather, it was nice to enjoy a picnic on the lawn or spend time reading a book.
4. Convenient accessibility and facilities

Jamsil Hangang Park is accessible on foot from Jamsilnaru Station on Subway Line 2. The park is well-equipped with convenient facilities such as convenience stores, restrooms, and shower rooms, so you won't have any inconveniences even if you stay all day. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby, so it was nice to enjoy a light meal after visiting.
5. Various events

Various events are held in the park each season. In the spring, you can enjoy flower viewing on the banks of the Han River, and in the summer, you can enjoy special events such as the Han River All Summer Festival. The fireworks display with Lotte World Tower, which has a beautiful night view, is also a highlight that cannot be missed.
Overall review

Jamsil Hangang Park is a place that stands out for its diverse activities and convenient facilities that can be enjoyed leisurely in nature. It is located in the city center, so it is highly accessible, and it is a space where everyone can enjoy healing in their own way. If you want to spend an unforgettable time with the beauty of the Han River, be sure to visit Jamsil Hangang Park.

reviews.text:
Pungpung Arcade is a recently renovated arcade located in the center of Jamsil Saenae.
During the Jamsil Saenae era, it was operated under the signboard “PpungPung Game Land Sincheon 1st Branch” or “World Carnival,” but it felt very old because it had the feel of an old arcade.
I was very surprised by the name change to Bbungbung Arcade and the atmosphere that was similar to the latest arcades that have opened recently.

The first floor was set up with a claw machine and the second floor was set up with an arcade machine, which was the same.
The doll claw machine is mainly equipped with Coco-chan and Dollhouse machines, and the dolls are large in size and of various types, so it was fun to look around to see which one to pick.

The second floor is equipped with basic arcade games and action game machines such as Soundwave, House of Dead, Pump, Pixelcraft, and Basketball Pro.
There are game consoles of each type that are consistently popular, and the lights come out well and the sound is loud, so it's fun to play!
However, because space was limited, it was a bit disappointing that there were only a small number of devices of the same type.

The second floor felt a bit hot due to the heat radiating from the game console, so I played a classic claw machine on the first floor to relive old memories.
As always, I expected the force of the claws to be weak, but the fact that it was set to be weaker than expected seems to need improvement.
The bill exchange machine was operating normally on each floor, making it convenient to use the entertainment.

Pungppong Arcade in Jamsil Saenae, where you can enjoy a variety of arcade machines and claw machines.
The atmosphere of the arcade has been changed to suit the new generation and the fact that you can enjoy the latest arcade games in Jamsil Sae-nae seems like fun guaranteed, so I stop by every time I come.
If you are traveling or visiting Jamsil or near Jamsil, enjoy some fun entertainment with your acquaintances, lovers, friends, and family!

reviews.author: Bong
reviews.text:
The guards here must receive etiquette training.
On Thursday, June 6th, around 10:50 PM, I visited with my vehicle to return the equipment I had borrowed. I didn't know before visiting that the building closes at 11 p.m., so I decided to leave after hearing the security guard who came at 11 p.m. asking me to leave.
However, as I was about to leave, this security guard said he did not believe it was my first time coming and told me to leave as he would open the shutter door. Because his tone was so irritating, I asked him why he was doing that and asked him to stop. He shouted profanity at my car as it was leaving the car. When I told him to stop and be careful because I was recording it with a black box, he only stopped swearing.
This is a large shopping mall and is visited by many people, but on the other hand, it is very disappointing that the security guards here do not have the appropriate culture.

reviews.text: Jamsil Saenae, Exit 2. Isn’t this the most convenient shopping mall closest to the subway station? I went in briefly to buy writing utensils, but the smell of food from the side dish store located at the entrance was so strong that I was afraid my clothes would smell. Normally, I would have enjoyed looking around... I don't know if it was because of today or because it was lunch time, but wouldn't it be a bit difficult for the store owners on the same floor?  Think about it.
